summary.text: Michael Way is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 15, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Way graduated from Arizona State University and later obtained an MBA/JD from the University of Wyoming.
The profile says Way has spent a career in business and is married to Raimee, with four children.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 15 (candidate-submitted statements)
